sources.definition_or_claim: Risk-free maturity should match cash-flow timing/duration; ideal zero-coupon instrument; nominal/real cash-flow and discount-rate consistency; long-term valuation typically uses long-term government rate.
sources.claim_strength: direct primary method, not an empirical test of this dashboard
sources.limit: TTM earnings yield is not a duration-matched cash-flow forecast; 5Y coupon yield is not an exact five-year risk-free zero-coupon return

sources.definition_or_claim: Same-maturity nominal less TIPS yield is inflation compensation/breakeven; TIPS payments adjust with CPI; model page has daily observations from 1999 but generally weekly publication.
sources.limit: Risk premiums affect breakeven; staff research product may be delayed, revised, or method-changed; do not label pure expected inflation

sources.definition_or_claim: Breakevens incorporate inflation risk premiums and differential liquidity of TIPS and nominal securities.
sources.frequency: model table; not used for observations
sources.claim_strength: direct official caveat from search result, page not separately opened
sources.limit: Not used to infer current expected inflation

sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
sources.definition_or_claim: Treasury yields comprise expected future short-rate path plus term premium; premium compensates rate-change risk and is unobservable, model-estimated; maturities 1–10Y.
sources.claim_strength: official search excerpt; direct open returned site shell without model body
sources.limit: Model estimates are not official NY Fed/FOMC positions; raw 10Y−5Y slope does not identify its underlying components

sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED
sources.definition_or_claim: T5YIE derives from DGS5 and DFII5, same 5Y maturity; percent, not seasonally adjusted.
sources.limit: FRED description calls it market expected inflation, but Fed Board caveat means breakeven is not pure expectation

sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED
sources.definition_or_claim: T10YIE derives from DGS10 and DFII10, same 10Y maturity; percent, not seasonally adjusted.
sources.limit: Same inflation risk and relative-liquidity caveat

algebra.strength: identity if EY, dates, units and Treasury basis are matched
algebra.not_claimed: independent stock signal or measured return improvement

recommendation: Keep existing 10Y EY spread as primary long-horizon observation; if useful show 10Y-5Y slope and matched nominal/real/breakeven decomposition in detail, not a second 5Y sigma opportunity rail without an explicit distinct decision and evidence.
unresolved: No local aligned historical or account-level test of whether 5Y slope or real/inflation decomposition improves decisions; outside source-only subtask.
